subject: Re: AtlasAI renewal — activation schedule & monthly commit for 16-GPU reserved pool
body:
---- Message 1 (Earliest) ----
From: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@atlasai.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com; tom.keller@atlasai.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + scale — questions on proration and go-live window

Hi Aisha,

We reviewed the renewal summary you sent last week — thank you. A couple of quick clarifying items before procurement starts the PO:

- If we move from the current 8-GPU reserved pool to 16-GPU, how do you handle the billing in the first month (prorated activation vs full-month commit)?
- We need a firm go-live window for the new capacity (our SREs want a 72-hour window to validate traffic ramp). Are you able to guarantee activation within a specific date range?
- Can you provide the updated throughput guarantee (tokens/sec or QPS) per model for the 16-GPU profile? We need that for our internal perf gating.

Also, any chance we can get a short ops checklist to run with our infra team during the migration?

Thanks,
Alexa
Alexa Johnson
Director, Infrastructure Engineering — AtlasAI

---- Message 2 ----
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@atlasai.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai; sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.ai; procurement@atlasai.com; tom.keller@atlasai.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + scale — questions on proration and go-live window

Hi Alexa — great questions. High-level answers below; attaching a proposed SOW + activation checklist for the 8→16 transition. Please see the attachments for line-item billing language we recommend for the PO.

- Proration: We will prorate the month of activation. If activation occurs mid-billing-cycle, you pay a pro-rated portion of the new 16-GPU commit for the remainder of that month plus the prior 8-GPU invoice for the previous period. Next full month will reflect the 16-GPU monthly commit. (Attachment: SOW_AtlasAI_8to16_v2.pdf)
- Activation SLA: For Reserved capacity upgrades we commit to a 5-business-day activation SLA from signed SOW + payment confirmation. For AtlasAI (enterprise tier) we can tighten to a 72-hour activation window if you include a one-time expedite fee (documented in SOW v2, section 3.2).
- Throughput guarantees: We provide per-model throughput baselines in the SLA addendum; for your most-used models (Llama-variant / seq len 1024) the 16-GPU pool maps to approximately 2.6x sustained tokens/sec compared to 8-GPU under our batching profile. Exact measurable QPS depends on prompt length and KV cache usage — see SLA_Addendum_16GPU.docx for the calibrated numbers we tested with your sample prompt set.

Next steps suggested:
1) Review attached SOW and SLA addendum — let me know redlines.
2) Procurement issues PO referencing the SOW (we can accept PO + DocuSign combo).
3) Once signed, ops schedules a blackout-free 72-hour activation window; Redwood will run parallel warm-up traffic and KV prefetch.

Adding Rishi and Sergio from our deals/ops teams for pricing and activation sequencing.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--- Attachments referenced: SOW_AtlasAI_8to16_v2.pdf; SLA_Addendum_16GPU.docx; activation_checklist.xlsx

---- Message 3 (Internal) ----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasAI renewal — pricing cadence for 16-GPU commit

Folks — quick internal note before we send a final SOW to AtlasAI procurement:

- List price for 16-GPU pool (monthly reserved) = $72,000/mo. Current 8-GPU commit = $40,000/mo. We recommended a mid-point discount (term-based) -> customer-friendly listed monthly = $60,000/mo if they sign a 12-month renewal.
- Expedite activation fee (72-hour SLA) = one-time $5,000. We can waive for a 24-month term or credit-back in month 2 if they upsell within 90 days.
- Ops note: schedule a parallel warm-up for 12h on day 0 and sustained traffic ramp across days 1–3. Need to reserve burst capacity of +2 GPUs across the fleet for safe cutover. Sergio, confirm capacity reservation plan?

If AtlasAI pushes for start-of-month billing only (no proration) we can accommodate if they commit to a 13-month prepay structure and we give a 7% additional discount.

rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

---- Message 4 (Internal) ----
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasAI renewal — pricing cadence for 16-GPU commit

Confirming ops plan:
- Can allocate 16-GPU dedicated pool in 72 hours with expedite fee, or 5 business days standard. Will reserve +2 GPU burst buffer to handle warm-up.
- Will pre-warm KV cache for top-20 prefixes and seed model states before traffic ramp.
- We need AtlasAI to sign the activation checklist and share IP allowlist so we can validate network access.

I'll add these bullets into the SOW and push an updated DOCS link to HubSpot.

Sergio
Head of Solutions Operations | Redwood Inference

---- Message 5 (Latest) ----
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alexa Johnson <alexa.johnson@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai; sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.ai; tom.keller@atlasai.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasAI renewal — activation schedule & monthly commit for 16-GPU reserved pool

Hi Alexa / Atlas procurement —

Thanks for the quick review. Per our internal follow-ups above, attached is the revised SOW that:
- Redlines the billing language to explicitly call out proration on activation month;
- Adds the expedite option (72-hour SLA) and the one-time expedite fee;
- Includes throughput baselines in the SLA addendum for your three production models;
- Appends the activation_checklist.xlsx for your SREs to confirm pre-cutover items.

Requesting the following to move forward:
1) Sign the attached SOW (DocuSign link below) or return a PO that references the SOW by name (SOW_AtlasAI_8to16_v2).
2) Confirm preferred activation window (we recommend 2026-11-08 → 2026-11-11) and whether you want the standard 5-business-day activation or the 72-hour expedite.
3) Share the IP allowlist + time-of-day blackout windows for your traffic so ops can schedule warm-up safely.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ATL-2026-085
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/54421/ATL-2026-085
Drive SOW link: https://redwood.share/drive/AtlasAI/SOW_v2

If procurement signs by end-of-day Nov 3 we can make the proposed Nov 8 go-live with the expedite SLA.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---- End of thread ----
